claim.power: Conditional on a fixed D0, under Xt iid~Q != P, sufficiently small k, and Delta_k>0, Algorithm 1 stops with probability one.
claim.stopping_time: As k tends to zero, E[tau] is O(Delta_0^-2 log(1/(alpha Delta_0)) + Delta_0^-2).

verification_route: Independent corrected symbolic derivation, not finite simulation.
required_obligations: Map the paper loss to the standard logarithmic ONS regret theorem.
Construct a feasible fixed benchmark for both the interior and boundary cases.
Lower-bound benchmark log-growth by C0^2 Delta0^2/4.
Derive almost-sure crossing from the strong law and sublinear regret.
Bound benchmark log-variance by a constant times its mean.
Give an explicit burn-in satisfying the regret/threshold inequality.
Sum a valid Bernstein geometric tail to obtain the stated Delta0 order.
Check continuity from k=0 to sufficiently small positive k.
Detect the invalid unconstrained-maximizer equality and tail-rate substitution in the printed proof.

verdict_rule.VERIFIED: Every corrected proof obligation and both error-detection controls pass in the symbolic verifier and independent checker.
